title: flame thrower
description: This plugin modifies the ghast's fireballs, which you can throw. The controls are simple: right-click and it fires. The plugin doesn't explode, it only sets fire within a six-block radius. You can adjust the rate of fire per second
body: This plugin adds a new, special ghast ball to the game that fires an infinite number of balls. The number of balls can be configured in the config. Also, when the ball hits the ground, it doesn't explode everything around it; it only sets everything within a six-block radius on fire. It's the perfect weapon for having fun with friends. It can also be used to defend against other mobs, if you enjoy survival games
